items.title: Mancini reappointed Italy boss after Pirlo controversy
items.dek: Roberto Mancini is appointed Italy manager for a second time - just a day after Andrea Pirlo rules himself out of the running for the job and technical director
items.body: Roberto Mancini is appointed Italy manager for a second time - just a day after Andrea Pirlo rules himself out of the running for the job and technical director Paolo Maldini resigns.
items.author: IriLine Desk

items.title: Gironde wildfires pick up as French region braces for new 40C heatwave
items.dek: Firefighters are braced for a sharp rise in temperatures on Wednesday, which could complicate the containment of wildfires.
